plugins.name: scott-skills
plugins.description: Scott's personal workflow skills: wayfinder → drain → map-review → specify → spec-review → tickets → ship (wave workflows — plan, implement, verify on two axes — looping until a closing pass is clean), driven stage-by-stage with /next or conducted end to end with /next auto, plus diff-review, design, domain-modeling, domain-expansion, grilling, prototype, research, and tdd.
